intro: North Macedonia has a small economy based on farming, wine and foreign-owned factories.

chapters.title: Farms and factories
text: Tobacco, grapes, vegetables and the red pepper relish ajvar are well known, and the Tikveš region produces much of the country's wine. Foreign companies make car parts in special economic zones.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Unemployment and emigration of young people are major concerns, and air pollution in Skopje is bad in winter.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with tax breaks to attract foreign companies.
